issue_description.description: No defect was reproduced in the assigned scope. The desktop and mobile focused Playwright test passed and asserted canonical URL, social title, document title, email payload, and provider parameters across the 11 blog routes and 4 longform routes that render the floating rail. The repository migration check passed for all 12 articles. A separate isolated two-pass migration produced byte-identical output and matched each generated imageCaption value to the corresponding legacy hero caption. Astro checks, 51 unit tests, the production build, and distribution verification also passed. The full E2E command was not completed because an existing unrelated process occupied port 8787 before its preview server started; this did not affect the focused two-project E2E test, which completed successfully.

Isolated migration: Verified deterministic two-pass output and caption parity for 12 articles. Astro check: 0 errors Unit tests: 51 passed Build and verify: 21 HTML files and 20 public routes verified ```
